Definition: Dishon, the name of two Edomites
BiblicalUsage: Dishon was the name of two Edomites in Seir's family: the fifth son of Seir, and the son of Anah his grandson. The record keeps them apart by their fathers, and the name means thresher.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Bible's care with two men of one name shows me that God knows each person by more than a label.
